# Vendored Lua

This directory contains the unmodified Lua 5.1.5 source distribution from
`https://www.lua.org/ftp/lua-5.1.5.tar.gz`.

SHA-256:
`2640fc56a795f29d28ef15e13c34a47e223960b0240e8cb0a82d9b0738695333`

Bahamut compiles the Lua library directly into the x86 client runtime. The
standalone interpreter, compiler, operating-system library, I/O library,
dynamic-loader library, and debug library are not built into the runtime.
The upstream license is in `COPYRIGHT`.
